newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal cuts Bank of NY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruntal cuts Bank of NY.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it cut the rating on Bank of New York Co Inc to outperform long term from outperform
-- Analyst Katrina Blecher says near term weakness expected, suggests long term investors hold positions, short-term investors lock in gains on part of holdings
-- Analyst says earnings are running below earlier projections due in part to slower than expected replacement of revenue from sale of Union credit card portfolo
-- Bank of New York up 3/8 to 28-5/8 in morning trade
